environment_setting: Country B, Suburban neighborhood where disputes over property boundaries are common due to unclear land demarcations.
norm_base: Citizens Committing forcible entry or forcible detainer Imprisonment up to 2 years or punishable on summary conviction

character_profile.name: John Smith
character_profile.goal: expand his backyard by claiming disputed land

legitimate.legitimate_action: Filing a legal claim to resolve the property dispute
legitimate.benefits: Potentially gains legal ownership of the disputed land, avoids legal trouble
legitimate.costs: Legal fees, time-consuming process, potential stress

illegal.illegal_action: Forcibly erecting a fence on the disputed land without legal resolution
illegal.benefits: Immediate use of the land, emotional satisfaction of claiming the area
illegal.costs: Imprisonment up to 2 years or punishable on summary conviction, potential conflict with neighbors

legitimate.legitimate_action: Mediating between John and the other party to resolve the dispute peacefully
legitimate.benefits: Maintains neighborhood harmony, avoids escalation of conflict
legitimate.costs: Time and emotional energy spent on mediation

illegal.illegal_action: Encouraging John to forcibly claim the land to avoid prolonged disputes
illegal.benefits: Quick resolution of the issue, avoids prolonged legal battles
illegal.costs: If discovered, could face legal consequences for incitement

character_profile.name: Michael Brown
character_profile.goal: secure a contract for building fences

legitimate.legitimate_action: Advising John to resolve the dispute legally and offering to build the fence after legal resolution
legitimate.benefits: Earns income from the contract without legal risks
legitimate.costs: Delays in starting the project, potential loss of the contract if John decides otherwise

illegal.illegal_action: Agreeing to build the fence on the disputed land without legal resolution
illegal.benefits: Immediate income from the project, strengthens business relationship with John
illegal.costs: If discovered, could face legal consequences for aiding in forcible entry
